item.title: Kubeflow
item.description:
Goal

Kubeflow is a process that allows you to deploy machine learning infrastructure on top of a Kubernetes cluster. The goal here is to deploy Kubeflow first on a local simple Kubernetes cluster running in a VM and then deploy it in the Kubernetes PI Cluster
